headline: Lead Platform Engineer | Cloud Infrastructure
page_title: Rajendra P N - Lead Platform Engineer
summary_html: Lead Platform Engineer with 10+ years of experience enabling reliable application delivery, cloud infrastructure, and production operations. Builds reusable CI/CD workflows for microservices and APIs, integrates automated testing and code-quality controls, and standardizes Kubernetes deployments across Azure and AWS. Partners with developers to investigate logs, isolate build and runtime defects, coordinate database dependencies, and improve application responsiveness. Hands-on Python, Bash, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Maven, Terraform, and observability experience; collaborates through sprint planning, technical reviews, and operational feedback.

achievements.text: Built Jenkins shared libraries and Python services that automate onboarding, artifact publication, and microservice delivery.

experience.title: Lead Platform/DevOps Engineer
impact: Built Azure landing-zone foundations with modular Terraform for networking, identity, storage, and AKS, standardizing parameters and reviewed infrastructure changes.
Managed Terraform remote state in Azure Storage with state locking and environment isolation; integrated policy checks and approval gates into infrastructure delivery.
Developed reusable GitHub Actions workflows for microservice and API releases, integrating automated tests, artifact promotion, protected environments, and deployment verification.
Standardized GitHub repository policies, Packages/GHCR consumption, branch protection, and OIDC cloud access to improve developer self-service and release traceability.
Applied Azure Policy, managed identities, and Key Vault controls; integrated IaC, secret, dependency, and container checks into shared platform workflows.
Operated AKS with Helm and Argo CD, maintaining deployment health checks, workload identity, private service access, autoscaling, and recovery procedures.
Correlated application errors, Kubernetes events, and Azure telemetry during incidents; partnered with developers to isolate root causes and improve diagnostic logging.
Supported Milvus and GPU-enabled services across Azure/AWS infrastructure; reviewed resource utilization, tagging, and capacity to improve AI workload readiness and cost visibility.
Reviewed platform code and deployment PRs, mentored engineers, and prioritized reliability fixes with application teams during delivery planning.
Automated release concurrency and API smoke checks with GitHub Actions and Python, detecting configuration and connectivity failures before production handoff.
Automated environment prerequisite checks for DNS resolution, service endpoints, and required configuration, catching deployment blockers before release execution.
Created reusable Python diagnostics to collect workload status and recent failures, giving developers consistent evidence for application troubleshooting.
Reviewed container resource requests and deployment settings with service owners, addressing capacity constraints and unstable application startup behavior.
Maintained release recovery checklists and verified rollback inputs in nonproduction environments, improving readiness for failed application deployments.
Published platform onboarding examples and troubleshooting documentation, helping application teams adopt shared pipelines and resolve common configuration issues.

Validated reusable workflow changes in isolated test jobs, checking input contracts, artifacts, and failure handling before adoption by application teams.
